New ikkath shirt which is made by hand, handloom products. Ethinic handloom ikkath shirts for men. New ikkath shirts woven by hand. buy now Men ikkath handloom Shirts woven whale .

In Ikkath the resist is formed by binding individual yarns or bundles of yarns with a tight wrapping applied in the desired pattern. The yarns are then dyed. The bindings may then be altered to create a new pattern of ikkath and the yarns dyed again with another colour. This process may be repeated multiple times to produce elaborate, multicolored patterns. Men ikkath handloom Shirts woven whale. When the dyeing is finished all the bindings are removed and the yarns are woven into cloth. In other resist-dyeing techniques such as tie-dye and batik the resist is applied to the woven cloth, whereas in ikkath the resist is applied to the yarns before they are woven into cloth. Because the surface design is created in the yarns rather than on the finished cloth, in ikkath both fabric faces are patterned . we woven whale have the best quality of ikkath handloom mens wear buy now at low price.
